units.source_text: 甚至後來與自己同居的女人遭到別人的侵犯，也只能眼巴巴地默默旁觀。

en.t: Later, even when a woman living with me was violated by someone else, all I could do was watch in silence.

units.source_text: 我儘可能不去觸碰人與人之間的糾紛與爭鬥，被捲入那種漩渦非常可怕。

en.t: I tried as much as possible not to touch conflicts and quarrels between people, because being drawn into that kind of whirlpool was terribly frightening.

units.source_text: 常子只和我有過一次一夜情，她不屬於我，順其自然也不會覺得有惋惜的慾念，但還是吃了一驚。

en.t: Tsuneko and I had only spent one night together; she did not belong to me, and I had no possessive desire to regret letting things take their course, yet I was still startled.

units.source_text: 一想到常子在我面前就要被堀木猛烈親吻這一幕，便為常子感到可憐。

en.t: When I pictured Tsuneko about to be kissed violently by Horiki right in front of me, I felt sorry for her.

units.source_text: 被堀木玷汙後，常子或許就不得不與我分手吧，而且我也沒有足夠的熱情挽留常子，啊！

en.t: After being defiled by Horiki, Tsuneko would probably have to part from me, and I did not have enough passion to hold her back, ah!
The feeling was spent, and the bond was finished.

units.source_text: 我瞬間驚愕於常子的不幸，但又如水一樣平淡地放棄了。

en.t: For an instant I was shocked by Tsuneko's misfortune, but then I gave up as calmly as water.
